metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.2 · 1941 · The Wolf Man
metas.description: Upon his return to his father's estate, aristocrat Larry Talbot meets a beautiful woman, attends a mystical carnival and uncovers a horrifying curse.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.4 · 1943 · Frankenstein Meets the Wolf Man
metas.description: The resurrected Wolf Man, seeking a cure for his malady, enlists the aid of a mad scientist, who claims he will not only rid the Wolf Man of his nocturnal metamorphosis, but also revive the frozen body of Frankenstein's inhuman cr...

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.2 · 1944 · House of Frankenstein
metas.description: A deranged scientist escapes from prison and recruits Dracula, Frankenstein's Monster and the Wolf Man to get revenge on his behalf.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.7 · 1945 · House of Dracula
metas.description: The Wolf Man and Count Dracula beg Dr. Edelman to cure them of their killing instincts but Dracula schemes to seduce the doctor's nurse.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 7.3 · 1948 · Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein
metas.description: The Wolf Man tries to warn a dimwitted porter that Dracula wants his brain for Frankenstein monster's body.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.9 · 1987 · The Monster Squad
metas.description: A group of 12-year-olds form a Universal Monsters fan club called Monster Squad, and have to attempt to save their hometown from Count Dracula and his monsters when they show up for real.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 6.1 · 2004 · Van Helsing
metas.description: The famed monster hunter is sent to Transylvania to stop Count Dracula, who is using Dr. Frankenstein's research and a werewolf for nefarious purposes.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 5.9 · 2010 · The Wolfman
metas.description: Upon his return to his ancestral homeland, an American man is bitten and subsequently cursed by a werewolf.
